text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship didn't show up even though it was time for training,
so while I was searching around the academy...

text_block_list.name: Tree Fairy?
text_block_list.text:
...Dat's right-pi☆
If ya wanna get faster, ya gotta pump those arms-pi!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks!
I'll give it my all, fairy!

text_block_list.name: Tree Fairy?
text_block_list.text:
Just gotta take on the challenge-ppo!
I'm rooting for ya-ppu☆
Out of nowhere, Gold Ship came jumping down from a tree.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean? I'm just playing fairies...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, today's training day?!
Ahaha, it totally slipped my mind!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My bad, my bad!
Forgive me this once, for Golshi-chan's sake!

I gave Gold Ship a stern warning
to be more careful in the future.
